messages.text_d2f0098ec404: A singer and composer expressing a variety of worlds through music and words.
messages.text_36ab1c73b6a1: Her name is written in English as Toma Source. Singing and composing are at the heart of her work across music projects with different lineups and creative worlds. Ishtar, Shinshoku, Kamimusuhi and Emerald Tablet each bring together different works and performers.
messages.text_8bed8fcec25f: Live Digest videos are a good way to discover her singing; talks and interviews offer a way to explore her personality and ideas. There’s no need to learn all the names at once.
messages.text_0d1fc6e1a44b: “Toma-san,” “TOMA” and “Toma Source” all refer to the same person.
messages.text_856fdd8dee89: The story of traveling aboard the spaceship Ishtar shapes the music and the language used at performances. Audiences join the journey as “crew,” becoming part of its participatory world.
messages.text_a3f8107f0c66: Works include Chikai, Connect a New World and Kyōshin Kyōmei. Live shows may have their own series names. Distinguishing between a work, a performance and a project can make announcements easier to understand.
messages.text_68fa6d6d7132: Words such as “setting sail” and “boarding” in live announcements belong to this creative world.
messages.text_b35fbe8bdc56: A music project whose works include Gyakushin and Taimatsu.
messages.text_333df68b43d7: A music project centered on Toma Source and music producer Masaro Kamata. Its works include Gyakushin and Taimatsu. Introductory talks discuss the different Japanese meanings layered into the name, including priesthood, true color, new color and new planting.
messages.text_7987a082e799: Although this is also Toma’s work, its background and themes differ from Ishtar’s. Check the project name in a video’s title, then try its introductory or live-guide talk.
messages.text_a324d789505f: The name is written “Shinshoku” and pronounced shin-shoku.
messages.text_3ff4af335870: A vocal duo featuring Toma Source and Sayuri Aburakawa. They draw on places throughout Japan and scenes from its ancient past, expressing them in song and sound. Their activities include live shows and musical offerings at shrines.
messages.text_709ee2783b97: Amemusubi is a work title, while Kamimusuhi is the duo’s name. Seeing both in an announcement does not mean they are separate performers.
messages.text_b808ecc05fb1: When you see a collaborator called “Sayuri-san,” the Sayuri Aburakawa entry may help.
messages.text_53d092b9a877: A project combining Toma’s voice and narration with Eriko Oi’s crystal bowls.
messages.text_99c2efc69166: A music project combining Toma Source’s voice and narration with Eriko Oi’s crystal bowls. It explores the world of the writings known as the Emerald Tablet through sound and words.
messages.text_5d1afeaf9b9e: Works include Sōzō no Tankyū (Exploration of Creation) and Seimei no Hana (Flower of Life). In a talk, “Emerald Tablet” may refer to the writings or to a musical work or performance, so context matters.

messages.text_11785a201a20: An experiential meditation program connected with Toma Source and Eriko Oi’s Emerald Tablet project. It is presented as a practice intended to harmonize inner energy and connect with vitality and creativity.
messages.text_400131719c1f: Follow the music and narration while lying down or focusing on your breathing and bodily sensations. Terms such as “magnetic poles,” “activating the star system” and “zero realm” express the program’s spiritual worldview.
messages.text_6184b3068700: You can experience it through the official YouTube video released in March 2023, with English and Japanese subtitles. Begin by exploring its sound and narration.

messages.text_156b4cf29ceb: The number of times a vibration repeats in one second, measured in hertz (Hz).
messages.text_eadf7a5059f1: In sound, frequency is a basic term related to pitch. For example, 440 Hz means 440 vibrations per second. It is a different property from loudness.
messages.text_fc24712eb00a: In Toma’s talks, “frequency” may also describe how a person or place feels. Distinguishing a numerical description of sound from a metaphor for feelings or relationships helps clarify the meaning.

messages.text_99e07c85c301: It does not mean that every note in a piece has the same pitch. In Toma’s work, read it alongside the release description as a clue to the sound design or artistic concept.

messages.text_8676cdb619f9: Adjusting an instrument’s pitch to a reference.
messages.text_303887ac7863: When instruments play together, musicians tune them against a reference pitch. A common example is setting the note A to 440 Hz.
messages.text_8573975f8275: When another number appears in a work’s description, check what is being used as the reference. A different number alone does not determine performance quality or a listener’s experience.

messages.text_03bc1ad2edd3: Components layered above a fundamental tone that help shape the sound of a voice or instrument.
messages.text_14942f8c2e46: The basic frequency of a sound is its fundamental. Components at whole-number multiples of that frequency are harmonics. Their relative strength changes the tone of a voice or instrument, even at the same pitch.
messages.text_4f8ca9755f41: The term also appears in discussions of Toma’s voice. Listen to how musicians describe its layered or rich sound to explore the idea further.

messages.text_dfa65f56bac6: A first step, made by fans
messages.text_bcc601b71428: This is the guide website of TOMA Oshikatsu Club, an unofficial fan community. It is operated separately from Toma Source’s own official website and the official TOMA BOX fan club.
messages.text_6fc7876f7830: Our glossary and video introductions draw on public streams, profiles and materials, organized with newcomers in mind. Experiences and impressions vary. Read descriptions in the context of each work’s creative world and the speaker’s own expression.
messages.text_c7c0b58407f7: Videos are accompanied by publication dates. Dates and ticket conditions mentioned in older videos may differ from current information. Check each organizer’s latest announcements for current events, prices and eligibility.
messages.text_10716c06ebb1: We use external forms for joining and inquiries. YouTube video and stream information, thumbnails and embedded players load as you browse; videos do not autoplay. For information about data use, cookies, external services and requests for corrections or deletion, see our

messages.text_5de91aa24852: How we handle information and use external services.
messages.text_f651df180ff5: As a guide to an unofficial fan community, this website handles information according to the following policy. It is operated separately from Toma’s own official website and the official TOMA BOX fan club.
messages.text_27545f0b2338: Website operator: Kazuhiro Mori (Morikyun), Head of the IT Department, TOMA Oshikatsu Club
messages.text_9b4efb4fe1c4: Joining form responses and applications managed by: Ren, the club’s founder
messages.text_b0d462836cbb: For questions about personal information, corrections or removal of listings, and other inquiries, please use our

messages.text_3b347076b90c: 2. Information we receive and how we use it
messages.text_094aacaabbb3: collects your preferred department, name, phonetic reading, Facebook name, whether you can use Messenger, email address and anything you enter in the comments field. We use these details to process membership, confirm your group, contact you and provide group activity information. The form indicates required and optional fields.
messages.text_78efe802fc60: Our Google Form collects your email address, inquiry category and message. We use them to reply and carry out necessary checks or follow-up. Depending on the form’s settings, Google sign-in may be required. Responses are handled by the people responsible for addressing the inquiry.
messages.text_5ede5e3ba8dc: We use listing requests, confirmation of membership, proposed profile and channel information, and recommendations to consider a listing and contact the applicant. Ren, the founder, manages applications. The department heads’ meeting decides whether to accept recommended listings. Information needed for that decision is shared with the relevant department heads and their meeting.
messages.text_4c990e0a1180: Information entered in forms is not automatically published on this website.
messages.text_71864071e7e9: Within the scope of the person’s confirmed request and consent, we introduce their professional or personal name, prefecture, role, description, YouTube channel name and URL, and TOMA BOX membership. Titles, publication dates and thumbnails of public videos from listed channels are displayed automatically. Videos may cover subjects unrelated to Toma.
messages.text_697392475b75: Email addresses, private correspondence and department-head deliberations received through applications or inquiries are not included in fan profiles. Contact us below to request changes to or removal of a profile.
messages.text_20004c0170a0: This website uses the following services. External links open in a new tab when clicked.
messages.text_94f17a632419: We use Cloudflare to deliver pages and images, retrieve video and blog information, and protect the website. When you visit, information such as your IP address, access time, requested URL, browser and connection details is transmitted to and processed by Cloudflare. Security cookies and logs may be used depending on the settings and features in effect.
messages.text_8c23df1c1c19: YouTube / Google: videos, streams and thumbnails
messages.text_9d369e64d09e: This website uses YouTube API Services and public YouTube RSS feeds. As pages are viewed, our server retrieves public video information and thumbnails load from Google’s image host (i.ytimg.com). There is no consent button for displaying this content. The latest-video section loads embedded players in privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com), without autoplay. Loading images or players, and playing videos, sends information such as your IP address, browser details and referring page to Google. Google / YouTube may also process information about playback and player interactions. Privacy-enhanced mode does not eliminate information transmission. Google’s use of cookies and related technologies depends on service settings and browser restrictions.
messages.text_d590efc68c40: Search terms and prefecture filters are processed in your browser and are not sent to the YouTube API. We do not request access to your Google account or retrieve private videos or viewing history.
messages.text_25742d720116: This website’s YouTube-related features are subject to the
messages.text_c5d4a2b0f6f4: . For information about data handling, read this page and the
messages.text_a282495db5fc: . YouTube’s terms and policies also apply after you open an external YouTube page.
messages.text_2c786e3fb2fc: Formzu, Google Forms and Facebook Messenger
messages.text_e307c7757ac6: We use Formzu for joining applications and Google Forms for inquiries. When you open, complete and submit a form, the relevant service processes the information you enter and connection information. Facebook Messenger is used for communication and group activities. Each service has its own cookies, storage features, terms and policies.
messages.text_5d9c2d2dd77b: Toma Source’s official website: live event listings
messages.text_433e33e01282: Our server retrieves public information from the official event page to display event names, dates and venues. Displaying this list alone does not connect your browser to the official website. After following a link, consult that website’s information-handling policies.
messages.text_44604bd2ba96: Our server retrieves public RSS feeds from Toma’s, the staff’s and the club’s blogs to display post titles, publication dates and links. Displaying these lists alone does not connect your browser to Ameblo. After opening an article, consult the destination’s policies.
messages.text_80de0cf02bc7: External services may process information outside Japan according to their providers’ policies.
messages.text_863fc93a9cb8: We do not run our own advertising, access analytics or browsing-history storage. The feature that stored your YouTube display preference in the browser has been discontinued. Any old setting remaining in your browser is not used for the current display.
messages.text_be1386356f5e: External services may use cookies or browser storage when images or embedded players load or play, or when you use linked services. Consult each service’s policy above for its purposes and practices.
messages.text_bad0756e901e: You can manage and delete cookies and site data through your browser settings. Restricting external content or cookies may prevent embedded videos or other features from working. You can also use the Watch on YouTube links.
messages.text_69ddc30fe834: 6. Retention, correction, deletion and stopping use
messages.text_184825b277f7: Ren, the founder, views and manages joining form responses and YouTube listing applications. We handle information as needed for operations and responses, separating public information from private contact details. We do not sell information for advertising. Except for processing by service providers, legal requirements and similar cases, we do not share information with third parties for other purposes without the person’s consent.
messages.text_4aea4d628e9e: For information handling when leaving the club or ending a listing, contact Ren through Facebook Messenger. If you do not know how to make contact, or wish to request access, correction, deletion or cessation of use, please use our
messages.text_46985f17e461: . We may verify your identity and will explain how we can respond. We have not set a uniform retention period or an automatic deletion deadline when someone leaves or is not listed.
messages.text_e73b355276e1: Public video and blog information is temporarily cached on the server for recent-content listings and checked when updated. Joining and inquiry responses are not stored in this video cache.
messages.text_54339eeba56a: We update this page when the services we use or our practices change.

messages.text_0103e30dc4e4: Forever our leader, Tomochan | TOMA Oshikatsu Club
messages.text_196250d55afa: A little album for Tomochan, leader of the TOMA Oshikatsu Club: photographs with friends, laughter, and dreams shared. Remembering the moments and connections we treasure.
messages.text_d75975973040: so many friendships, thanks to you, Tomochan.
messages.text_2490f52489c0: Here we keep the times we shared
messages.text_a621859631eb: and the bonds that are still with us.
messages.text_9682cccccb21: Tomochan smiling and raising a hand in a bright venue
messages.text_b04f3f60a862: A place to see that smile again.
messages.text_65047a91751f: 伊藤友隆, known to us as Tomochan, was the leader of the TOMA Oshikatsu Club.
messages.text_36c49d00eb4f: He turned a shared love of Toma into time we could all enjoy together.
messages.text_4bce800a1ec2: As the club’s leader, Tomochan helped our circle of friends grow alongside Ren. At venues and on livestreams, he made time for everyone to enjoy being together.
messages.text_7c7841228a08: Friends on the other side of the screen.
messages.text_bd6a6e4280da: TOMANIA LIVE began in March 2025. Through conversations with Yossy and many other guests, Tomochan shared his love of Toma and the joy of live music.
messages.text_0cc4d6dec192: That smile as he shared his dreams.
messages.text_8567da2bacba: He wanted to share his passion for koji and fermentation, from Japan to the world. Talking about the future with friends and taking steps toward what he loved were also part of who Tomochan was.
messages.text_973942fb76a1: This little album remembers Tomochan, who passed away on October 7, 2026, and preserves the memories he shared with friends.
messages.text_40d5cd26983b: Concert days, and the little moments before and after.

messages.text_9ddd6c3309b0: Sharing a meal, sharing a laugh.

messages.text_1fcf1b2e13e3: Helping make those shared moments possible.
messages.text_6bfc2821350d: Tomochan smiling beside a friend in a bright venue
messages.text_e22dd175a7da: Even an ordinary moment becomes a treasured memory.

messages.text_ebad6c3316b5: Three recordings that offer a glimpse of Tomochan as we remember him.
messages.text_3b043421f569: Yossy joins as the very first guest. The opening broadcast is a conversation about Toma and the joy of being a fan.

messages.text_ba038d258baf: How he discovered Toma, and the concerts that moved him. Hear Tomochan tell his story in conversation with 神山真希.
messages.text_c45fa6a0b2e3: Sharing the culture of koji from Japan with the world. Join the conversation as he talks with friends about his dreams and plans.
